name: Dripshipper
summary: Private-label coffee and tea dropshipping for Shopify: they roast, bag and ship from their own US facilities within 3-5 business days, with your brand on the packaging.
best_for: someone who wants a turnkey private-label coffee or tea brand on Shopify — their roasting and packaging, your label on the bag — and is content to stay inside one product category
skip_if: you want product breadth, fulfilment outside the US, or control over sourcing and packaging cost — this is a single-supplier pipeline and the higher tiers only add coaching
honest_knock: Read the ladder before you climb it. Starter already carries unlimited orders, unlimited products and automatic fulfilment — the whole product, in other words. Professional at $99 adds live monthly training, priority support and a success manager; Elite at $197 adds monthly one-on-one coaching on top. You are buying people, not capability: nothing above Starter makes the coffee ship faster or cost less per bag. The annual rate is the move worth noticing in the other direction, since $240 a year against $30 a month is a third off the same tier. Beyond that the model is narrow by design — one product category, roasted and shipped from their own US facilities in 3-5 business days, with no route to source elsewhere or negotiate the per-order cost.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per month, or $240 a year which works out at $20 a month
pricing.notes: (re-read 2026-10-19 on apps.shopify.com/dripshipper, listed as “Dripshipper: Coffee & Tea”, and on dripshipper.io/pricing) Starter $30 a month, Professional $99 and Elite $197, each listed with a 14-day free trial — all three unchanged since 19 August 2026. The help centre's cancellation article (2 September 2026) contradicts that for Elite, saying it has no trial and bills immediately. Starter is also sold annually at $240 a year, which is $20 a month for the same tier, and it is the only tier with a published annual rate. The listing does spell out what the steps buy: Starter carries unlimited orders, unlimited products, automatic order fulfilment, a dedicated support team and 1-click product add; Professional adds live monthly training, priority support and a dedicated success manager; Elite adds monthly one-on-one coaching on top. Product and shipping cost is charged per order on top of the subscription, as a Dripshipper invoice rather than a deduction from your checkout. An FDA-Compliant Address Service is a separate $30 a month add-on. Dripshipper's own pricing page shows no annual rate; the $240 Starter annual appears on the App Store listing only. All charges are billed in USD and recur every 30 days. The listing now carries 159 reviews averaging 4.8, up from 142 averaging 4.7 on 19 August, distributed 130 / 14 / 7 / 4 / 4 from five down to one on 17 September; on 19 October the listing still showed 159 at 4.8, now with 131 five-star, 13 four-star and 8 three-star. Developer The Doughty Organization; the app launched 11 April 2018.
